items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: Yeah I have a daughter, Wendy, class of ’85.

ctx.x: Uh huh. Did you have another one too?
Yeah I have a daughter, Wendy, class of ’85. My son is the class of ’78, my daughter is the class of ’85. And by that time there was a lot of drugs.
Uh huh. Well my daughter just graduated from here also.
